item.title: On Easter, Pope Leo delivers commanding message of peace to a world at war
item.summary: “Let those who have weapons lay them down!” the first American pope declared. The White House’s war in Iran and nativist agenda at home are testing the Vatican.

item.title: Trump threatens Iran with ‘Hell’ over Strait of Hormuz in profane post
item.summary: Trump escalated threats against Iran’s power plants, bridges and other infrastructure in an expletive-laden post on Truth Social on Easter morning.

item.title: Trump files emergency appeal to keep building White House ballroom
item.summary: “Time is of the essence!” Justice Department lawyers wrote, saying a ruling to pause construction puts the president at risk.

item.title: Trump administration’s secrecy on health deals alarms experts, governments
item.summary: A dearth of information has been disclosed about the agreements, fueling speculation that the “America First” approach to foreign aid is exploitative.

item.title: Virginians deeply divided on Spanberger months after her landslide win
item.summary: A Washington Post-Schar School poll finds that Virginia voters are highly polarized over Gov. Abigail Spanberger (D), who ran as a unifying centrist.

item.title: Supreme Court sides with Steve Bannon in bid to dismiss Jan. 6 conviction
item.summary: The influential right-wing podcaster spent four months in prison for defying a subpoena from the House panel investigating the 2021 assault on the U.S. Capitol.
